reason: Pre-alpha, one developer, and it wants to run agents unattended on our client code overnight. I juggle client projects, so I am not going to be the first team to try that.
objection: Agents working alone on client repos at night, built by a single person with no track record. If something leaks or breaks, it is my name with the client.
would_change_my_mind: A few agencies I know using it for months, plus a clear security write-up on what the agents can touch, and a real GitHub following.
